incumbent_comparison: Compared with accepted v003 and matched Batch 0/1 production captures. v005 replaces the largely unarticulated roof and wall mass with a framed timber storehouse, paneled loading doors, roof seams, loading equipment and strapped supplies. It is materially more legible and detailed without losing depot identity or footprint.
next_action_hypothesis: Promote v005; preserve the RoomDefinition depot landmark, resource storage and construction systems.

observations.art_direction_fit: The constructed timber, iron and copper storehouse fits the approved miniature settlement direction.
observations.close_up_quality: Door panels, braces, straps and supply details remain coherent at close distance.
observations.gameplay_readability: The depot reads beside live citizens and remains presentation-only at its existing site.
observations.geometric_detail: The render shows layered boards, paneled doors, braces, roof seams, crates, barrel hoops and pulley assembly.
observations.material_realism: Oiled timber, dark iron, copper and stone respond differently under RoomScale lighting.
observations.proportion: Godot reports bounds within the specified depot envelope.
observations.scale_fidelity: Validation and settlement capture retain the intended miniature scale.
observations.semantic_recognizability: Three-quarter and room-context views read as a miniature clockwork supply depot with loading front and stored goods.
observations.silhouette_quality: Pitched metal awning and framed loading front distinguish the depot at settlement scale.
observations.surface_variation: Board courses, roof seams, crate bands and metal fittings vary visibly.
observations.technical_integration: Godot 4.7.2 validation passes and the exact v005 GLB renders through the review registry.

close_inspection.evidence: The close render resolves door framing, braces, roof seams, crate straps and supply details without assembly defects.

edge_treatment.evidence: Door panels, roof seams, crate edges and frame members have controlled edges.

hardware.evidence: Straps, pulley and door fittings read at close distance.

joins.evidence: Board courses, braces, posts and framed doors meet in coherent joints.

manufacturing_detail.evidence: Loading assembly, door construction, bracing and strapped supplies read as manufactured parts.

material_response.evidence: Wood, iron, copper and stone respond distinctly under production light.

surface_variation.evidence: Boards and supply surfaces vary in color and roughness.

thickness.evidence: Plinth, awning, wall, doors and crates have credible relative thickness.

neutral_viewer_realism.evidence: A viewer reads the framed doors, board construction and loading equipment as a believable miniature storehouse.

photo_character.evidence: No photograph is attached to this ArtBrief; review is based on the construction brief and production render.
